harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 with a PAM limits.d drop-in (/etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf) setting nofile=8192 and nproc=256 (soft and hard) for its login sessions. Verified via a real login shell (`su -l`/`sudo -u appworker -i`) before and after a full node restart, confirming both persistence and correctness.
actions_performed: Created local user 'appworker' on node1 via useradd -m
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with nofile 8192 (soft/hard) and nproc 256 (soft/hard) for appworker
Verified limits via an interactive login shell as appworker (ulimit -Hn/-Sn/-Hu/-Su)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and account/limits state as baseline
Issued a native systemctl reboot on node1 with async acknowledgement
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart, proving an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified appworker account and its login-session ulimits after restart

evidence.summary: id/getent passwd show appworker (uid 1000) exists before and after restart

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: limits.d config content and a real login shell's ulimit -Hn/-Sn (8192) and ulimit -Hu/-Su (256) confirm both soft and hard limits applied, pre- and post-restart
Pre-restart boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 plus healthy appworker account/limits captured
systemctl reboot issued asynchronously and acknowledged before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connectivity lost during reboot (connection reset/timeout), then exec succeeded again with new boot_id 13cd0c31-1de4-4dcf-ad4c-af6f00766d29, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: recovered state post-restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows appworker account intact and login-session ulimits still 8192 files / 256 processes
